cmawro-q004239-11-1-1-pound-paste.title: Pound sulphur, gypsum and red paste together
cmawro-q004239-11-1-1-pound-paste.description: Sulphur, gypsum and red paste are pounded together into a mixture.

cmawro-q004239-11-1-1-recite-tear-out-so.title: Recite "Furious, furious … tear out the sorcery"
cmawro-q004239-11-1-1-recite-tear-out-so.description: The incantation "Furious, furious, arisen evil …" ends with a command to tear out the sorcery.

cmawro-q004239-11-1-1-recite-into-paste-.title: Recite into the paste; apply it to the door-jamb
cmawro-q004239-11-1-1-recite-into-paste-.description: The incantation is recited three times into the mixture, which goes on the door-jamb of the man's house gate.

cmawro-q004239-11-1-1-wash-off-into-clot.title: Wash the paste off with silt into a cloth
cmawro-q004239-11-1-1-wash-off-into-clot.description: Afterwards the mixture is washed off with silt, into a cloth trimming, and the harm is released.

cmawro-q004239-11-1-1-wrap-sulphur-oil-i.title: Wrap sulphur and oil in combed fleece
cmawro-q004239-11-1-1-wrap-sulphur-oil-i.description: An alkaline plant, henbane(?) and a good mixture, with sulphur and oil, are enclosed in combed fleece.

cmawro-q004239-11-1-1-bury-at-gate-and-s.title: Bury it at the outer gate and door socket
cmawro-q004239-11-1-1-bury-at-gate-and-s.description: The fleece deposit is buried at the outer gate and at the door's pivot socket, so that the sorcery is lost and cannot come near the man and his house.
